item.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
item.description:
【the-decoder.com】Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder.

item.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
item.description:
【machinelearning.apple.com】We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming…
